purpose: Separate prompt length from retained information by re-serializing each content class in a standard and a compact form, with no filler text and no change of numeric precision.
moment_order_rationale: Binned moments are a discrete Fourier transform of the 24 bin masses, so harmonics 1 to 12 invert the histogram exactly (max reconstruction error 1.4e-15 on this panel). Raising the order would change the retained information, which this control holds fixed; the order-12 limit is the centers arm in another notation and is already an arm of the primary design.
primary_contrast_definition: Delta = mean_field TV(centers_compact, moments_standard) - mean_field TV(centers_compact, centers_standard). The first pair differs in content and by 182 prompt characters; the second pair is information-identical and differs by 458 prompt characters. Delta > 0 favours content over length.
secondary_contrasts: TV(moments_standard, moments_compact) as a layout-only reference within the moments content class
rank correlation of the six pairwise TVs with content mismatch versus with absolute prompt-length difference
within-variant between-block TV as the noise floor
scope_note: This is a serialization control on the frozen 48-field replay panel. It does not re-run the collective experiments and makes no claim about closed-loop outcomes.
